title: Economics of machine intelligence: texts from 1952 to 2026 that state, contest or bear on its propositions
question: Which located texts, from 1952 to 2026, and one earlier text, Wiener’s Cybernetics (1948, wording attested 2019), recorded on M06a, state, contest or bear on propositions about the economics of machine intelligence? Three strands are recorded. The first is the debate over whether machine intelligence could make economic growth explosive. The second is how mainstream economics treated automation, computers and AI. The third is how economists took up recursive self-improvement, superintelligence and existential risk from AI, ideas mostly discussed outside economics. For each proposition, which text by an economist is the earliest located, and which text outside that group?

For each proposition, which text is the earliest located?
